actions.name: pick_sticks
actions.description: Pick up sticks from the ground. Sticks are used to craft various items.

actions.name: pick_stones
actions.description: Pick up stones from the ground. Stones are used to craft various items.

actions.name: pick_fibers
actions.description: Pick up fibers from plants. Fibers are used to craft various items.

actions.name: cut_wood
actions.description: Cut down trees to gather wood. Wood is used to craft various items. Requires an axe.

actions.name: eat
actions.description: Eat to restore hunger. Consume berries or fish if available in your inventory.

actions.name: pick_berries
actions.description: Pick berries from bushes. Berries can be stored for later consumption.

actions.name: fish
actions.description: Go fishing to catch fish. Fish can be stored for later consumption and provides more sustenance than berries. Requires a crafted fishing rod.

actions.name: drink
actions.description: Drink water to restore thirst.

actions.name: craft_rope
actions.description: Craft a rope using 3 fibers. Ropes are used to craft other items.

actions.name: sleep
actions.description: Sleep to restore health and reduce stress.

actions.name: explore
actions.description: Explore new areas on the map to discover resources and locations.

actions.name: craft_axe
actions.description: Craft an axe using 2 sticks and 1 stone. The axe is used to cut wood.

actions.name: craft_pickaxe
actions.description: Craft a pickaxe to mine valuable resources like iron and gold. Requires 1 wood and 1 stone.

actions.name: pick_sail
actions.description: Find and collect an abandoned sail in the forest, essential for crafting a raft.

actions.name: craft_compass
actions.description: Craft a compass to navigate with the raft. Requires 2 gold and 3 iron.

actions.name: craft_torch
actions.description: Craft a torch to illuminate dark areas and reduce stress. Requires 1 stick and 1 fiber.

actions.name: build_firepit
actions.description: Build a firepit to alleviate stress. Requires 2 wood and 4 stones.

actions.name: craft_fishrod
actions.description: Craft a fishing rod for catching fish. Requires 1 stick and 1 rope.

actions.name: build_shelter
actions.description: Build a shelter to rest and maintain your health. Requires 4 wood, 2 sticks, and 1 rope.

actions.name: build_raft
actions.description: Build a raft to escape the island. Requires 15 wood, 5 sticks, 3 ropes, 1 sail, and 1 compass.

actions.name: mine_gold
actions.description: Mine gold, a key material for crafting a compass.

actions.name: mine_iron
actions.description: Mine iron, a crucial resource for crafting a compass.
